blockers.resolution: Auto-applied: tmux send-keys -t ps5-hive 'curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/generate -d "{\"model\":\"qwen3.6-abliterated-q3km\",\"prompt\":\"hello\",\"stream\":false}"' Enter && sleep 2 && tmux send-keys -t ps5-hive 'pkill -f ollama; sleep 1; ollama serve > /tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 &', Enter

learned.description: On 500-rate spike, restart Ollama, suppress telemetry, and inject jittered backoff to break retry storms.
learned.example: pkill -f ollama; sleep 1; ollama serve > /tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & export HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 && sleep $((RANDOM % 10 + 5))

learned.description: Injects circuit-breaker delays plus telemetry suppression to prevent HTTP 500 retry storms.
